description: Config form spec for one disk Sensor entry in devicecfg.json Sensors[]. Flattened Properties; native DTDL writable + Enum coverage; the rest is in config-rules.js. Disk sensors require Parameters.MountPoint.
comment: MountPoint is REQUIRED for every disk Sensor (no auto-detect). MountPoint required + non-empty rule enforced by config-rules.js (rules.disk). usage_percent -> 'double'; every other disk MetricName -> 'long'.

schemas.description: Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType='disk'.
SensorGroup allow-list for disk sensors. Conventionally 'SYS'.
Wire schema allow-list. usage_percent -> 'double'; every other disk MetricName -> 'long'.

contents.name: Name
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty ASCII string, 1..128 chars, unique within Sensors[]. Uniqueness enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Name
UI hint: text input on create; read-only after.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: SensorGroup
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from the SensorGroup enum (disk sensors use 'SYS').
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorGroup
UI hint: dropdown, default 'SYS'.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: MetricType
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'disk' for this Interface.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricType
UI hint: fixed label, not editable.
Writable: immutable -- changing it requires defining a new Sensor.

contents.name: MetricName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from DiskMetricName.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricName
UI hint: dropdown.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: MountPoint
contents.description:
REQUIRED (disk-specific).
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string filesystem mount path (e.g. '/', '/data', 'C:\\'). DTDL v2 cannot express the required + non-empty rule; enforced by config-rules.js (rules.disk) and ConfigRules.MountPointRequired.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MountPoint
UI hint: text input, no auto-detect. Suggest the host's known mount points as a datalist.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: Enabled
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: boolean.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Enabled
UI hint: toggle / switch.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able (SIL2 maintenance lever).

contents.name: Interval
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: integer, 1 <= v <= 300000 (5 minutes). Range enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Interval
UI hint: number input, min=1, max=300000, step=100, default=30000.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Description
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Description
UI hint: textarea or text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: DisplayName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.DisplayName
UI hint: short text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Schema
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'double' when MetricName='usage_percent'; MUST equal 'long' for every other DiskMetricName. Cross-field rule enforced by config-rules.js; the agent rejects startup on mismatch.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Schema
UI hint: dropdown auto-selected by MetricName.
Writable: immutable after creation.
